questions.title: Practical space propulsion
questions.brief: Compare real propulsion options (chemical, nuclear thermal, ion, solar sail, laser-pushed, antimatter) on specific impulse, thrust, and mission capability. Identify which enable interstellar transit and at what cost.
groundTruth: ion Isp 3000-10000 s but very low thrust
rocket equation delta-v = Isp * g0 * ln(m0/mf)
questions.deliverable: A ranked table with numbers, and the single biggest engineering blocker for each.
